items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: There was a guy named Mitch who had a hunchback. INTERVIEWEE: You almost said it. Not (?), but a little cat. Looked something like Shad Collins. He had a name around Chicago.

ctx.x: No. He could play. But he wasn't so fond of Louis, because Louis...
He wasn't a hunchback, was he? There was a guy named Mitch who had a hunchback.
You almost said it. Not (?), but a little cat. Looked something like Shad Collins. He had a name around Chicago.
